_why: How much each era counts toward Rokugan's price of every good (feature 223). An era not named weighs 1. The GM sets these: 'how representative we think they are of our setting' (2026-10-25). The Chinese eras weigh 1 by the GM's ruling (2026-10-25: Rokugan is geographically more like China than Japan, so China is as valid as Japan for these weights). Meiji Tokyo 1882 weighs 1 for its food by the GM's ruling (2026-10-25: villages had changed little), but its cloth (linen) and lamp oil (kerosene) are marked excluded in its era file: the opening changed them, and both sit below every Tokugawa era's range. Edo 1860-67 and Beijing 1900-19 await diagram's answer on which of their goods foreign trade changed. Rice is the anchor and does not move; only goods priced beside rice in an era count there.
